list.label: Page
list.name: page
list.description: Matched Blazor route template. Filters page transitions, page HTTP, route counts and document entry-page panels; component and log panels retain their own scope.

panels.title: Recently reporting runtimes (3 min)
panels.description: Runtimes reporting within three minutes, not users or online sessions. Closed, sleeping or throttled tabs can stop reporting. Empty does not mean an outage.

panels.title: Browser metric series (recently reporting)
panels.description: Live metric series, not retained storage volume. Each runtime GUID and histogram bucket creates series. Dashboard aggregation does not reduce ingestion cardinality.

panels.title: Page transition to first frame p95

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) (rate(browser_page_navigation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_navigation_type="navigation",browser_navigation_phase="first_frame"}[5m]))))

panels.description: Destination route; top 10 p95 values over 5 minutes. Time from committed navigation to a rendering opportunity. A loading indicator can be that first frame; compare page HTTP below for data loading. Missing samples stay empty; no zero is invented.

panels.title: Page HTTP request duration p95

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) (rate(browser_page_http_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}[5m]))))

panels.description: Outgoing HTTP duration by the page on which the request started, including requests that finish after a navigation. Telemetry export is excluded by Core. Top 10 p95 over 5 minutes; this is per-request duration, not total page-ready time.

panels.title: Page routing and render-frame p95

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route, browser_navigation_phase) (rate(browser_page_navigation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_navigation_type="navigation",browser_navigation_phase=~"route_match|render_frame"}[5m]))))

panels.description: route_match: navigation event to framework route match. render_frame: route match to a rendering opportunity. Both are measured separately; percentiles must not be added. Async data loading may continue after either phase.

panels.title: Observed page transitions and HTTP requests / 10 min
panels.description: Measurement counts give context for latency percentiles. Only completed navigation frames count. Increase requires exported counter samples; the first observation can be undercounted. Empty means no observations, not an application outage.

panels.title: Page ready p95 and failed load ratio

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((rate(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome="success"}[5m]) and (time() - timestamp(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome="success"}) < 180)))))

100 * (sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((rate(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome="error"}[5m]) and (time() - timestamp(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome="error"}) < 180))) or on (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((0 * sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((rate(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome=~"success|error"}[5m]) and (time() - timestamp(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome=~"success|error"}) < 180)))) unless on (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) count by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome="error"} and (time() - timestamp(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome="error"}) < 180))))) / on (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) (sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((rate(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome=~"success|error"}[5m]) and (time() - timestamp(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`,browser_page_load_outcome=~"success|error"}) < 180))) > 0)

panels.description: Successful page-ready p95 (seconds, left axis): navigation through observed data loading to a rendering opportunity, reported by PageLoadObserver. Includes initial loads and SPA transitions. Top 10 p95 routes over 5 minutes. Failed load ratio (percent, dashed, right axis): error / (success + error); cancelled loads are excluded. Missing observations and zero completed-load rate stay empty. Only samples exported in the last 3 minutes contribute.

panels.title: JavaScript errors/sec by page

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route, browser_error_kind) ((rate(browser_javascript_errors_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}[5m]) and (time() - timestamp(browser_javascript_errors_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}) < 180))) or on (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((0 * count by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`} and (time() - timestamp(browser_page_load_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}) < 180)))) unless on (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) count by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) ((browser_javascript_errors_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`} and (time() - timestamp(browser_javascript_errors_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}) < 180))))

panels.description: Uncaught JavaScript errors and unhandled promise rejections, grouped by route template and error kind. Core limits reports per runtime; this is the rate of reported errors. Zero requires page-load telemetry exported within 3 minutes and no fresh JavaScript error series for that page. A first error sample is not replaced with zero while its rate is unknown. Missing or sleeping runtimes stay empty. Error details are in browser logs and traces.

panels.title: Document startup and Web Vitals — entry page
WASM startup p95 — reporting runtimes

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route, browser_wasm_phase) (browser_wasm_startup_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`} and (time() - timestamp(browser_wasm_startup_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}) < 180))))

panels.description: Startup duration distribution across runtimes reporting within the last 3 minutes, grouped by document entry route and phase. Each runtime contributes one startup observation per phase; this is not a count of recent page loads. Runtime and document-to-runtime phases overlap. First frame is a rendering opportunity after runtime startup, not completion of asynchronous page data.

panels.title: Latest Web Vitals p75 — reporting runtimes
panels.description: p75 of latest document measurements among runtimes reporting in the last 3 minutes, grouped by document entry route. This is not a page-load distribution or a percentile of individual Blazor route transitions. INP is absent until an interaction is measured.

panels.title: Latest CLS p75 — reporting runtimes
panels.description: Unitless layout-shift score for the document. p75 of latest values among runtimes reporting within 3 minutes, grouped by entry route. It does not reset on each Blazor navigation; lower is better.

panels.title: Framework bytes per reporting runtime — entry page

targets.expr: avg by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) (sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route, service_instance_id) ((browser_wasm_resource_decoded_size_bytes_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`} and (time() - timestamp(browser_wasm_resource_decoded_size_bytes_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}) < 180))))

avg by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route) (sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, page_route, service_instance_id) ((browser_wasm_resource_transfer_size_bytes_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`} and (time() - timestamp(browser_wasm_resource_transfer_size_bytes_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",page_route=~`${page:regex}`}) < 180))))

panels.description: Average initial framework-resource bytes per recently reporting runtime, grouped by entry route. Includes all resource types. Transfer bytes can be zero for cached resources; decoded bytes are not managed heap usage. Neither is a resource download rate.

panels.title: Managed heap per reporting runtime — average / largest
panels.description: Approximate current managed memory among runtimes reporting within 3 minutes. Select a runtime instance to inspect one tab. Browser/native memory is not included. Runtime-wide data; the Page filter does not apply.

panels.title: GC memory snapshots per reporting runtime
panels.description: Average aggregate memory values reported by the GC. Snapshots can remain zero or unchanged until a collection occurs. Heap, committed memory and fragmentation overlap; do not add them together. Runtime-wide data; the Page filter does not apply.

panels.title: Managed allocation rate per runtime — average / largest
panels.description: Approximate allocated bytes per second across recently reporting runtimes. Mono updates allocation totals during GC, so flat intervals and spikes are expected. The first sample alone cannot establish a rate. Runtime-wide data; the Page filter does not apply.

panels.title: GC collections/sec by generation
panels.description: Collections per second across selected runtimes, grouped by the generation reported by Mono. Counter resets are handled per runtime before aggregation. GC-pause timings are unavailable in this WASM runtime. Runtime-wide data; the Page filter does not apply.

panels.title: Managed exceptions/sec by type

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, error_type) ((rate(dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}[5m]) and (time() - timestamp(dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}) < 180))) or on (service_name, deployment_environment_name) ((0 * count by (service_name, deployment_environment_name) ((browser_runtime_gc_heap_size_bytes{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"} and (time() - timestamp(browser_runtime_gc_heap_size_bytes{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}) < 180)))) unless on (service_name, deployment_environment_name) count by (service_name, deployment_environment_name) ((dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"} and (time() - timestamp(dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}) < 180))))

panels.description: All thrown managed exceptions, including caught exceptions and framework internals. Zero requires a reporting managed heap and no exception series. A first exception sample is not replaced with zero while its rate is unknown. Runtime-wide data; the Page filter does not apply.

panels.title: Managed exceptions in reporting runtimes — lifetime totals

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, deployment_environment_name, error_type) ((dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"} and (time() - timestamp(dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}) < 180))) or on (service_name, deployment_environment_name) ((0 * count by (service_name, deployment_environment_name) ((browser_runtime_gc_heap_size_bytes{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"} and (time() - timestamp(browser_runtime_gc_heap_size_bytes{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}) < 180)))) unless on (service_name, deployment_environment_name) count by (service_name, deployment_environment_name) ((dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"} and (time() - timestamp(dotnet_exceptions_total{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}) < 180))))

panels.description: Sum of lifetime exception counters for runtimes reporting within 3 minutes, including their first observed exception. These totals are not limited to the dashboard time range. They can decrease when tabs stop reporting. Runtime-wide data; the Page filter does not apply.

panels.title: Event handler p95

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, aspnetcore_components_type) (rate(aspnetcore_components_handle_event_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}[5m]))))

panels.description: Component handler duration, including awaited work. Low event counts make percentiles unstable.

panels.title: Render and parameter update p95
panels.description: Blazor processing time, not browser paint time, INP or page startup time.

panels.title: HTTP requests/sec
panels.description: Outbound client requests, including retries.

panels.title: HTTP client error ratio

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (service_name) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",http_response_status_code=~"4..|5.."}[5m]) or rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",error_type!=""}[5m])) or on(service_name) (0 * sum by (service_name) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}[5m])))) / sum by (service_name) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}[5m]))

panels.description: 4xx/5xx or transport errors, counted once per attempt. Zero appears only with observed requests; missing browser telemetry stays empty.

panels.title: Component errors/sec

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, error_type) (rate({__name__=~"aspnetcore_components_navigate_total|aspnetcore_components_handle_event_duration_seconds_count",service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}",error_type!=""}[5m])) or on(service_name) (0 * sum by (service_name) (rate({__name__=~"aspnetcore_components_navigate_total|aspnetcore_components_handle_event_duration_seconds_count",service_namespace="browser",service_name=~"${service:regex}",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${instance:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.description: Blazor event-handler and navigation exception observations. Validation messages and all JavaScript errors are not represented.

panels.title: Browser logs — open trace links for the full request
Recent browser traces
panels.description: Traces containing spans from the selected WASM service, environment and runtime. One table per selected service; open a trace to inspect WASM → BFF/YARP → API → database. No matching requests in the selected time range means no rows.

options.content:
Each WASM runtime has its own GUID, shared by metrics, logs and traces. It is not a user identifier. Follow a log trace link to inspect WASM → BFF/YARP → API → database.

No reports from a closed or sleeping tab are normal. Browser telemetry is diagnostic input from clients; BFF authentication assigns service/environment but does not make payload contents authoritative.

Managed .NET runtime metrics require Core 2.1.6 or later and apply to the whole runtime, independent of Page. CPU/RSS, GC pauses and JIT timings are unavailable in WASM. JavaScript errors are grouped by page and kind, with details in browser logs and traces (Core 2.1.5+). WASM startup and document Web Vitals are shown in their own section.

Page panels require page measurements from Core 2.1.3 or later. Page is a route template, never a concrete entity ID. Document panels use the entry route; Web Vitals do not reset on each Blazor navigation. Page latency panels separate a first rendering opportunity, individual HTTP requests, and PageLoadObserver-reported page readiness. Failed load ratio excludes cancelled navigation. Missing measurements remain empty.
